name: Sven Yorgen
summary: At the Hushed Bank, Sven Yorgen grieves his murdered family and seeks vengeance. He camps on the northern edge of the bank in western Duskwood with his companion Lars, determined to learn who ruined his home.

sections.title: A Life Shattered
sections.body: Sven Yorgen remembers Duskwood before Medivh's fall brought gloom to the region. Born before the First War, he spent years working the soil at the Yorgen Farmstead in southern Duskwood with his wife and children. Their quiet life ended when mysterious Dark Riders raided the homestead while Sven was away. They butchered his family and left the farm a graveyard.

sections.title: Vengeance from the Hushed Bank
sections.body: Unable to return to his ruined home, Sven made a secluded refuge on the Hushed Bank with his friend Lars. He distrusts outsiders and asks travelers to prove their loyalty before he shares his burden. Near the devastated farmstead, Sven saw a figure skulking about. He became convinced the stranger was responsible for the massacre or connected to the sinister horsemen who destroyed his life.

sections.title: Uncovering the Truth
sections.body: Jitters, an errant vagrant, was the shadowy figure stalking Sven's property. His blundering drew the Dark Riders into Duskwood as they searched for the Scythe of Elune. Jitters did not strike the fatal blows, but his actions unleashed the nightmare that destroyed the Yorgen family. Sven's fury now turns toward the dark forces haunting Raven Hill and the necromancer Morbent Fel.

faq.answer: Sven Yorgen farms from a small camp on the northern edge of the Hushed Bank in Duskwood. After his family was massacred at their homestead, he devoted himself to seeking retribution against those responsible.

While Sven was away, black-cloaked figures called the Dark Riders came to the Yorgen Farmstead. Searching for a powerful artifact, they slaughtered Sven's wife and children and left the land tainted by undead.

faq.q: Why is Sven hiding in the Hushed Bank?
faq.answer: Sven left his ruined farmstead after the massacre and made a temporary camp along the riverbank with Lars. He hides from the undead roaming western Duskwood while planning his revenge.

faq.q: Who is the shadowy figure Sven saw?
faq.answer: Sven does not know who the shadowy figure was. He saw someone skulking near the ruins of his homestead and asks trustworthy travelers to find out who it was and whether they had a hand in his family's deaths.

faq.q: Why did the Dark Riders attack Sven's farm?
aliases: what were dark riders looking for
faq.answer: The Dark Riders crossed Sven's lands while searching Duskwood for the Scythe of Elune, an ancient artifact of immense power. Their pursuit of the relic left death in their wake.

faq.q: How long has Sven lived in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Sven remembers Duskwood before it fell into darkness, so he lived there before the First War. The forest was still bright and peaceful, and Darkshire was known as Grand Hamlet.

angles.text: Sven's story reflects the collapse of rural life in the kingdom's frontier territories, where ordinary subjects face dark magic and shadowy horrors without protection.
Sven's heartbreak and thirst for justice speak to a paladin's duty to avenge innocent blood and purge the lingering undead raised across his family's soil.
